_about: Main menu, level transitions, pause and the final screen (tasks 4.2, 4.3). title: the big name on the main menu. background: the picture behind the menus, dim: how much it is darkened (0..1). fade_seconds: the screen fades to black and back in this long; title_card_seconds: the next level's title stays on black this long. unlock_in_order: false opens every level from the menu (playtests); true opens only passed levels and the one after the last passed (turn on before the jam submission, card И3). pause_on_focus_loss: the game pauses when the browser tab or the window loses focus. final: the screen after the last level.
